faq.question: Is Contractor Foreman a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. Contractor Foreman is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is Contractor Foreman priced?
faq.answer: Flat monthly plans from ~$49/mo — 30-day trial; confirm live tiers.

faq.question: Does Contractor Foreman have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 30 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Contractor Foreman?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
